Simulate data for a dynamic false-positive occupancy model

Source: R/simulate_fp_dyn.R
simulate_fp_dyn.Rd

Generates one dataset from known parameters for fp_occu_dyn(): the occupancy state of each site changes between seasons by colonization and extinction, and within each season it is observed as in simulate_fp(), by an automated method with false positives and, at a random subset of site-seasons, a verified method without them. This function is experimental (see crywolf-api).

Usage

simulate_fp_dyn(
  nsite = 100,
  nseason = 5,
  nocc = 4,
  psi1 = 0.5,
  b_psi1 = 0,
  col = 0.2,
  b_col = 0,
  ext = 0.2,
  b_ext = 0,
  p11 = 0.6,
  p10 = 0.05,
  r11 = 0.8,
  frac_verified = 0.2,
  nver = 2,
  frac_confirmed = 0,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

nsite

Number of sites.

nseason

Number of seasons.

nocc

Number of automated occasions per site and season.

psi1

Occupancy probability in the first season, at the mean of the site covariate x.

b_psi1

Slope of initial occupancy on x (logit scale).

col

Colonization probability at the mean of the season covariate rain.

b_col

Slope of colonization on rain.

ext

Extinction probability at the mean of x.

b_ext

Slope of extinction on x.

p11

True-detection probability of the automated method.

p10

False-positive probability of the automated method.

r11

Detection probability of the verified method.

frac_verified

Probability that a site-season is verified.

nver

Number of verified occasions per verified site-season.

frac_confirmed

Probability that an automated occasion is checked under the observation-confirmation design, as in simulate_fp(). 0 (default) for none.

seed

Optional integer seed.

Value

A list of class fp_sim_dyn with elements data (an fp_data object with a season column and the season covariate rain) and truth (the generating values, their logits named as the output of fp_occu_dyn() in pars, and the latent states z, a matrix with sites in rows and seasons in columns).

Details

The site covariate x and the site-season covariate rain are standardized normal draws; rain is returned in season_covs of the data. A transition into season \(t\) uses the covariates of season \(t\), as in fp_occu_dyn(). With frac_confirmed > 0, true and false observations occur independently on every occasion, and checked occasions get the columns n_true and n_false of auto.

See also

fp_occu_dyn(), simulate_fp()

Examples

s <- simulate_fp_dyn(nsite = 50, nseason = 4, seed = 1)
s
#> <fp_sim_dyn> 50 sites over 4 seasons
#>   truth: psi1 = 0.50, col = 0.20, ext = 0.20, p11 = 0.60, p10 = 0.050, r11 = 0.80
#>   realized occupancy per season: 0.56 0.50 0.46 0.48 
#> <fp_data>
#>   sites:                  50
#>   automated occasions:    800 (naive occupancy 0.84)
#>   verified sites:         35 (94 occasions; verified detections at 16 sites)
#>   sites known occupied:   16
#>   seasons:                4 (sites with data per season: 50 to 50, median 50)
#>   site covariates:        x 
#>   season covariates:      rain 
colMeans(s$truth$z)   # realized occupancy per season
#> [1] 0.56 0.50 0.46 0.48
